answer: Sybil defense can be priced through external corroboration. A claim is credited only when reviewers outside the answering cluster re-derive it from public state and sign, while citations that loop back inside the farm score nothing. A farm so trapped becomes a closed inlet: repetition circulates internally and never joins the wider current of judgment, so its hoped-for haven stays empty. Honest answers instead accumulate the way a walnut builds its shell, ring by ring, each layer testable by anyone. An attacker who wants credit must rent genuine outsiders and pay what honest labor pays.
